# Revision 10 (`585b666`), part A: test_delta_recipe, I's GPU run, R's Phase 5, S75 and S75b, the review history

*Referee V, 19 October 2026. Generated by `check_rev10_A.py` in this directory (`python3 -I docs/review_2026-10/rev10/check_rev10_A.py`, from the repository root after `git fetch`). The script reads git objects only, trains nothing and runs no session code. The test's own functions are cut out by ast and exec'd: `test_delta_recipe`'s `success`, `newcombe_paired`, `d1_label` and `report`; `test_window_gate`'s `success`; R's `r_transition` and `r_bound_routed`; and `explore_i_dense.routed`. `rlib.py` is the independent check alongside them. The other session's `recompute_*.py` were read and not run.*

**What was checked.** The report is `multichannel_hebbian_report_v10.tex` at `585b666`, the merge of `d2b7abd`. It is byte-identical to the scratchpad copy and is cited as `tex10:NNN`. The scope is every number and every factual or process statement in the text added since Revision 9 (`c918ff7`) that concerns:
- `test_delta_recipe` (X, L, pooled);
- I's GPU run;
- R's Phase 5;
- S75, including seed 839, and S75b;
- the referee and review history;
- the provenance rows and the status statements for these;
- the sentences on these in the abstract, conclusion and limits.

The fifth round's screens are out of scope here: E's batches 20–21, F's S88, G's S87 and H's S87.

**Records:**
- `test_delta_recipe`: X `8ae660d` and L `b03d353`, both unchanged at `585b666`.
- The GPU run: `claude/explore-I` `148c161`, with the note at `30807ec`.
- R: `31c39fc` (protocol `550a736`). The main line's split_copy records are at `592c574` and `ffb0771`.
- S75: `explore-I` tip `8d2e89f`. The results file is unchanged since `4371824`, which added seed 839.
- S75b's outputs and mutants: `explore-I` tip.
- The referee's files: `claude/review-V` and the main line.

## S75's tenth WIDE_SLOW seed (839)

The record was added at `4371824` (13 Oct 03:20 UTC) and is unchanged at the tip. It is on the GTX 1660 SUPER, under code SHA 5fb120a92d69, the same as S75's other records.

| | WIDE_SLOW 839 | WIDE_SPLIT 839 |
|---|---|---|
| end SET | 0.5333 | 0.5338 (difference −0.00048) |
| ROUTED at the end (`explore_i_dense.routed`, by ast) | no | no |
| end η² (L1) | 0.00029 | 0.00029 |
| max η² over 20 evaluations | 0.00061 | 0.00058 |
| one-to-one at any evaluation | 0 of 20 | 0 of 20 |
| end channel map | [1, 2, 1, 1] | [1, 1, 1, 1] |
| end margin | 0.026 | 0.025 |
| L2 probe at 1200 / max at 3600 / max at the end | 0.389 / 0.254 / 0.256 | 0.401 / 0.255 / 0.261 |

**It matches WIDE_SPLIT 839.** Neither is ROUTED, and their SETs differ by 0.0005. Over ten seeds:
- ROUTED pairs (split, slow) are (no, no) on all ten.
- WIDE_SLOW's SET is 0.5300–0.5360, against WIDE_SPLIT's 0.5293–0.5365.
- WIDE_SLOW's max η² is 0.00061, and 0 of its 200 evaluations has a one-to-one map.

tex10:481's "all ten: 0.530–0.536 against 0.529–0.536, η² below 0.001 at every evaluation, no one-to-one map at any" is MATCH, and so are tex10:68's "route 0/10 each" and report 2's table row (0/10 [0.00, 0.28] NEVER, 0.534 (0.530–0.536)). The one consequence the draft missed is row 50: seed 839 is a thirtieth gated run.
